NOTE: Nexusmods is the only site you can download this on. Any other site mirroring this mod is not authorized by me.

[center][font=Tahoma][size=5]﻿[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=5][color=#a4c2f4]More Galactic Galaxy Sword[/color]
[/size][/font][/center]Hello, all! I found that the galaxy sword was just really boring looking. It didn't seem like a super cool space sword that was given to you via magic rainbow shard transformation.

This mod changes:
[list]
[*]Galaxy Sword
[*]Galaxy Hammer
[*]Galaxy Dagger
[/list]
[u]How to install:
[/u]Unzip and move the 'weapons.xnb' file into 'Stardew Valley/Content/TileSheets' and let the new file overwrite the old one

This is my very first mod, so please let me know if you have any issues with this mod. They're probably my fault.
